_comment: Curated video sources (PRD-031 / RFC-033 S0). Author input for build-video-provenance.ts → static/data/video-provenance.json. We LINK, never host. Every `channel` must be oEmbed-verified as the official uploader (2 of 3 generic search hits are re-uploads) and must resolve in scripts/video-channel-allowlist.ts. Seed = iconic-firsts starter set, global spread (NASA / SpaceX / ISRO).
